Shardul Thakur claims underutilization during England Test series

Indian all-rounder Shardul Thakur has stated he was not utilized properly during a past Test series in England. He believes a "calculation error" led to him being underused, suggesting he could have made a greater impact with more bowling opportunities. Thakur also spoke about the importance of hope even when facing setbacks.
